summary: HEAD and the exact phase diff are verified. The fresh sample has 3 disagreements in 37 rows (8.11%), below the 15% stop threshold. Three D1 delete rows still conflict with rubric note 3. Per-file runner counts cannot be independently checked from the supplied baseline artifacts.
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] review-a: D1 rows for source scanners/card layout (classification.md:122), the reading-card cover and featured-row behavior (line 128), and cover dimensions/other-card behavior (line 129) are marked delete. These rows protect user-visible layout or image behavior, so rubric note 3 requires rewrite, not delete. Rationale: deleting these rows removes the behavior test instead of replacing it.
nonblocking_findings: F2 [Nit] review-a: baseline.json records only aggregate counts, and red-08bec4c-r2.log states that per-file counts were checked without listing those counts or the runner breakdown. Rationale: the 91 file rows sum to 3,175, but the required per-file comparison is not reproducible from the supplied artifacts.
evidence: The exact cbd023b1bd29333992f7511646cff1245191b049..1d4ddd2c02acea93c50c715e043391113f4b2c03 diff changes classification.md and plan.md only.

All four round-1 disagreements are corrected: removed-kind manifest rows are K (classification.md:96); the no-crop check is R2 (line 199); the live A34/A45 source tests are K, while the environment-dependent A34 check is D4 (lines 99, 111, 159); entrance visibility is D1 rewrite (line 120). Both A34 files and the A45 MANIFEST.txt exist in their configured locations.
Classification has 129 counted rows across 91 files; class weights sum to 3,175: K 2,843, D1 67, D2 22, D4 6, D5 221, R2 16. Seven additional rows are not counted, giving 136 table rows.

The fresh stratified sample contains 37 distinct rows and 322 counted cases. It excludes each exact row in second-check-08bec4c.json. It includes all remaining D1 delete rows, all non-reused D2 rows, all D4 rows, the tutor-commission rows, pricing rows reviewed, locale routing, accessibility, and three seeded random rows.

Sampling method: include mandatory strata first; use Python random.Random(20261123) to select three additional rows from unreviewed rows. The round-1 sample rows were excluded by file and case-label identity.
Fresh disagreement rates: 3/37 rows = 8.11%; 15/322 counted cases = 4.66%. The two Playwright rows contribute 9 non-counted cases and no disagreement.
